watch_keywords: Alameda County Registrar of Voters results
key_facts: UPDATED Wednesday August 19 (Post-Election Night; T+1d to Aug 20 res; TRIMMED Aisha Wahab 0.70->0.63, RAISED Melissa Hernandez 0.30->0.37; sum=1.00): (1) ELECTION NIGHT RESULTS (Alameda County ROV / AP / NBC Bay Area / USA Today 6:29am ET Aug 19, ~62% of est. 106K votes counted, AP uncalled): Batch 1 initial early-VBM (~59%, 62,606 votes) was unexpectedly tight — Wahab 32,149 (51.35%) vs Hernandez 30,457 (48.65%), lead +1,692 (+2.70%). Batch 2 overnight update (+2,836 votes = 2.7% of total, matching June 16 2% Election Day in-person share) broke sharply for Hernandez 1,586 (55.92%) vs Wahab 1,250 (44.08%), narrowing totals to Wahab 33,399 (51.04%) vs Hernandez 32,043 (48.96%, lead +1,356 / +2.07%). (2) COUNTING SCHEDULE & MATH: Alameda County ROV announced next updates Friday Aug 21, then Aug 26 and Aug 28. With ~40,000 late VBM ballots (~38%) remaining, Hernandez must win remaining ballots 51.70%-48.30% (+3.40 pts) — a +6.10 pt right swing vs Batch 1 early VBM — to overtake Wahab. (3) CALIBRATION: Wahab remains favored (0.63) given her banked +1,356 lead and Alameda County historical progressive/younger late-VBM tilt (Hayward/Fremont/Union City vs older early-VBM Tri-Valley), but trimming from 0.70 to 0.63 reflects the razor-thin 51-49 margin showing the $3.7M vs <$0.4M August outside blitz bit hard, plus late VBM will have lower Dem share than the 62.5% early firewall and higher exposure to mid-August anti-Wahab ads and Lofgren Aug 17 attack.
next_review_trigger: Check Aug 20 for any AP call/concession or unscheduled Alameda County ROV update, then Friday Aug 21 official Alameda County late-VBM ballot drop.
